Bound.Name: Bind
Bound.Effect: Can not take actions that require arms and hands.

Charmed.Name: Charmed
Charmed.Effect: Can not take actions that require arms and hands.

Feared.Name: Feared
Feared.Effect: Use all AP to move away from the enemy that applied the fear stack up to a specified range.  SP costs still apply.

Frozen.Name: Frozen
Frozen.Effect: Target can not take Actions and immune to damage instead reducing Stacks by Damage taken.  One stack still prevents all damage taken for the action that removes the last stack.

Grappled.Name: Grappled
Grappled.Effect: Attacker binds or roots target but can’t take further action with appendages used except to make unarmed constraining attacks against the target and may release as free reaction.  Constrain: 2AP: Squeeze target for STR physical damage.
Grappled.Upkeep: Upkeep:  May maintain Grapple.  Target Upkeep: Make opposing STR or SPT checks.  If Target succeeds, break grapple and take turn as normal

Pacified.Name: Pacified
Pacified.Effect: Can not attack.  Remove 1 stack when damaged.

Paralyzed.Name: Paralyzed
Paralyzed.Effect: Can't use SP. Lose stacks equal to damage taken.

Rooted.Name: Rooted
Rooted.Effect: Can not take actions that require legs and feet.

Asleep.Name: Asleep
Asleep.Effect: Can't activate verbal components or make sound based attacks. Lose stacks equal to damage taken.

Stunned.Name: Stunned
Stunned.Effect: Cannot take actions. Lose stacks equal to damage taken.

Crippled.Name: Crippled
Crippled.EndofTurn: If no move taken, remove 1 stack.

Hasten.Name: Hasten
Hasten.Effect: Increase initiative by stacks. If this would cause the turn of the active Character to move above a Character who has already acted this round, that Character does not take another Turn.
Hasten.Upkeep: Gain an AP and lose a stack.

Hindered.Name: Hindered
Hindered.Effect: Reduce SPD by 5 per stack. Lose a stack on Move.

Momentum.Name: Momentum
Momentum.Effect: Move SPD×2. Lose a stack when spending AP on a non-move action.
Momentum.EndofTurn: If no move taken, remove 1 stack.

Anticipated.Name: Anticipated
Anticipated.Effect: Defenses cost one less HP, SP, or MP. On defend: Remove a stack.

Quickened.Name: Quickened
Quickened.Effect: Increase SPD by 5 per stack. On move: Remove a stack.

Slowed.Name: Slowed
Slowed.Effect: Decrease initiative by stacks. If this would drop a Character below another Character's initiative, pause the Character's turn until the other Character's turn is complete.
Slowed.Upkeep: Gain 1 less AP then remove a stack.

Off-balanced.Name: Off-balanced
Off-balanced.Effect: Defenses cost 1 extra of each used pool: HP, SP, or MP. On defend remove a stack.

Baffled.Name: Baffled
Baffled.Effect: Reduce Max MP by 2 per stack. If MP hits 0, character is unconscious and all stacks are removed.  On MP use: Remove a stack.

Bleeding.Name: Bleeding
Bleeding.Effect: Lose 1 HP per stack per AP spent then remove a stack.

Bolstered.Name: Bolstered
Bolstered.Effect: Increase current and Max HP by 4 per stack.  When removing stacks, if current becomes less than Max HP, reduce current HP to Max HP.

Concentration.Name: Concentration
Concentration.Effect: Increase current and Max MP by 4 per stack.  When removing stacks, if current becomes less than Max MP, reduce current MP to Max MP.

Clarity.Name: Clarity
Clarity.Effect: Gain MP equal to stacks per AP spent then remove a stack for each AP spent.

Confused.Name: Confused
Confused.Effect: Lose MP equal to stacks per AP spent then remove a stack for each AP spent.

Demoralized.Name: Demoralized
Demoralized.Effect: Reduce Max SP by 2 per stack. If SP hits 0, character is unconscious and all stacks are removed.  On SP use: Remove a stack.

Depressed.Name: Depressed
Depressed.Upkeep: After MPR triggers remove 1 stack (even if no MP is gained).

Determined.Name: Determined
Determined.Effect: Gain HP equal to AP spent then remove a stack for each AP spent.

Enfeebled.Name: Enfeebled
Enfeebled.Effect: Reduce Max HP by 2 per stack. If HP hits 0, character is unconscious and all stacks are removed.  After being hit: Remove a stack.

Exhausted.Name: Exhausted
Exhausted.Effect: Lose SP equal to AP spent then remove a stack for each AP spent.

Flow.Name: Flow
Flow.Effect: SP costs are reduced by 1. On SP use: lose a stack.
Flow.EndofTurn: If no actions taken, remove 1 stack.

Focused.Name: Focused
Focused.Effect: MP costs are reduced by 1. On MP use: lose a stack.
Focused.EndofTurn: If no actions taken, remove 1 stack.

Inspired.Name: Inspired
Inspired.Effect: Gain SP equal to AP spent then remove a stack for each AP spent.

Invigorated.Name: Invigorated
Invigorated.Effect: Increase current and Max SP by 4 per stack.  When removing stacks, if current becomes less than Max SP, reduce current SP to Max SP.

Sickened.Name: Sickened
Sickened.Effect: SP costs are increased by 1. On SP use: lose a stack.
Sickened.EndofTurn: If no actions taken, remove 1 stack.

Stupified.Name: Stupified
Stupified.Effect: MP costs are increased by 1. On MP use: lose a stack.
Stupified.EndofTurn: If no actions taken, remove 1 stack.

Alert.Name: Alert
Alert.Effect: Gain +4 to Block and Dodge. After Blocking or Dodging, remove a stack.
Alert.Upkeep: If no defend action taken since last End of Turn, remove 1 stack.

Blessed.Name: Blessed
Blessed.Effect: Double healing received. Remove a stack per 1 HP lost.
Blessed.Upkeep: If healed since last End of Turn, gain 1 stack.

Blinded.Name: Blinded
Blinded.Effect: -4 to melee attacks and -8 to ranged attacks. -10 to defend actions if reliant on sight.

Defiled.Name: Defiled
Defiled.Effect: Reduce healing received by stacks. Remove a stack per 1 HP healed.
Defiled.Upkeep: If not healed since last End of Turn, gain 1 stack.

Disoriented.Name: Disoriented
Disoriented.Effect: -4 to attacks.  After attacking, remove 1 stack.

Distracted.Name: Distracted
Distracted.Effect: -4 to defends.  After defending, remove 1 stack.

Exploit.Name: Exploit
Exploit.Effect: Gain +1 Damage per stack on unblocked attacks. After attacking, remove 1 stack.

Leverage.Name: Leverage
Leverage.Effect: Gain +4 to attacks and abilities. After attacking, remove 1 stack.

Foresight.Name: Foresight
Foresight.Effect: Gain +4 to Dodge and Deflect. After defending, remove 1 stack.

Prone.Name: Prone
Prone.Effect: 1 AP to stand.  Reduce ranged attack rolls against this character by 2 and increase melee attack rolls against this character by 4.

Sanctified.Name: Sanctified
Sanctified.Effect: Increase healing received by stacks. Lose a stack per 1 HP healed.
Sanctified.Upkeep: If healed since last End of Turn, gain 1 stack.

Wounded.Name: Wounded
Wounded.Effect: Halve healing received. Remove a stack per 1 HP healed.
Wounded.Upkeep: If not healed since last End of Turn, gain 1 stack.

Sluggish.Name: Sluggish
Sluggish.Effect: -4 to Dodge and Deflect. After defending, remove 1 stack.

Staggered.Name: Staggered
Staggered.Effect: Can't perform more than one attack per turn or somatic spell components.
Staggered.EndofTurn: If no actions taken, remove 1 stack.

Barrier.Name: Barrier
Barrier.Effect: When Hit: Reduce physical damage by stacks, then lose stacks equal to Damage reduced by this effect. Prevents on-hit effects if damage is reduced to 0 by Barrier stacks.

Vile Mark.Name: Vile Mark
Vile Mark.Effect: When void damage taken: take extra Void damage equal to stacks, then lose that many stacks.
Vile Mark.EndofTurn: Lose a stack then take damage equal to the remaining stacks.

Brittle.Name: Brittle
Brittle.Effect: When physical damage taken: take double damage, then lose a stack.

Burned.Name: Burned
Burned.Effect: When fire damage taken: take extra fire damage equal to stacks, then lose that many stacks.
Burned.EndofTurn: Lose a stack then take damage equal to the remaining stacks.

Chilled.Name: Chilled
Chilled.Effect: When cold damage taken: take extra cold damage equal to stacks, then lose that many stacks.
Chilled.EndofTurn: Lose a stack then take damage equal to the remaining stacks.

Crushed.Name: Crushed
Crushed.Effect: When bludgeoning damage taken: take extra damage equal to stacks, then lose that many stacks.
Crushed.EndofTurn: Lose a stack then take damage equal to the remaining stacks.

Cursed.Name: Cursed
Cursed.Effect: When shadow damage taken: take extra damage equal to stacks, then lose that many stacks.
Cursed.EndofTurn: Lose a stack then take damage equal to the remaining stacks.

Empowered.Name: Empowered
Empowered.Effect: On hit: Double damage BONUSES, then lose a stack.
Empowered.EndofTurn: If an attack missed this turn, remove 1 stack.

Enraged.Name: Enraged
Enraged.Effect: +2 attack and -4 defense per stack.  When this character Hits remove 1 stack.  When this character is hit or misses an attack, gain 1 stack.

Grace.Name: Grace
Grace.Effect: On hit with Light:  Target takes additional damage or healing equal to stacks.  After each attack remove 1 stack.  Upkeep: Lose a stack then take Light healing or damage equal to stacks
Grace.Upkeep: Remove 1 stack and heal for stacks remaining.

Grit.Name: Grit
Grit.Effect: When hit: halve physical damage, then lose 1 stack.

Hardened.Name: Hardened
Hardened.Effect: When hit: Reduce physical damage taken by stacks, the remove that many stacks.

Poisoned.Name: Poisoned
Poisoned.Upkeep: Lose HP equal to stacks, then remove 1 stack.

Protection.Name: Protection
Protection.Effect: When hit: Reduce energy damage taken by stacks, the remove that many stacks.

Resistant.Name: Resistant
Resistant.Effect: When hit: Halve energy damage, then lose 1 stack.

Weakened.Name: Weakened
Weakened.Effect: On Hit: Half damage BONUSES, then lose a stack.

Weathered.Name: Weathered
Weathered.Effect: When slashing damage taken: take extra damage equal to stacks, then remove that many stacks.
Weathered.EndofTurn: Remove a stack then take damage equal to the remaining stacks.

Voidtouched.Name: Voidtouched
Voidtouched.Effect: Void damage or healing (undead) on hit: take extra Void damage or healing equal to stacks, then lose a stack.
Voidtouched.EndofTurn: Remove 1 stack then take damage if creature didn't apply it or if self-applied heal equal to the remaining stacks.

Vulnerable.Name: Vulnerable
Vulnerable.Effect: Double affinity BONUS damage taken.  Energy on hit:  Remove a stack.
